title: Phase 1 completion gate and baseline
goal: Confirm the semantic coverage workflow ended COMPLETE, record baseline counts and clean-state evidence, and create the Phase 2 evidence structure.

title: Residual Korean classification
goal: Scan English source files for Hangul, classify every hit, and fix only real untranslated English-source residue.

title: Markdown artifact cleanup
goal: Verify empty Markdown links, macro rendering artifacts, unknown macro strings, and hash-only Markdown attachment links are absent or explicitly classified.

title: Legacy attachment inventory
goal: Build a complete inventory of legacy attachment labels with no downloadable source URL and record them as no downloadable URL in source.

title: Technical URL-backed attachment verification
goal: Recheck technical document-format attachment links and confirm URL-backed technical attachment omissions remain zero.

title: FAQ URL-backed attachment verification
goal: Recheck FAQ document-format attachment links and confirm URL-backed FAQ attachment omissions remain zero.

title: English-only FAQE classification
goal: Classify English-only FAQE material separately from Korean-source-verified content for later consolidation.

title: Manifest and source metadata check
goal: Validate manifest.json, update metadata only if source files changed, and verify source counts remain stable.

title: Final stabilization report
goal: Create the final Phase 2 stabilization report with READY_FOR_LLM_CONSOLIDATION or RECHECK_REQUIRED and verification evidence.
